_help: store.json = everything you sell on the store. Prices, perks, coin packs, crate keys, page words and page colours all live here. Copy a { } block to add an item, delete a block to remove one. config.json has the server name, IP and Discord link; site.json has the homepage settings.

currency._help: The money players can pay in. 'rate' = how many of this currency equal 1 unit of 'base'. 'decimals' = digits after the decimal point (0 shows ₹449, 2 shows $4.99).

scroll._help: 'enabled': false freezes the store page (no background colour shift, no fade-ins). 'colourShift' moves the background colour as you scroll. 'reveal' fades cards and headings in as they reach the screen.

redirect._help: Where 'Buy now' / 'Continue to payment' sends players when the item has no orderLink of its own. Leave it empty to use the Discord link from config.json.

pages._help: One block per store page. 'navLabel' = the tab name in the store menu. 'colour' = the colour of the whole page (a name like gold, purple, blue or a hex value; empty = the site colour from config.json). 'cards' (coins and keys) are the packs for sale.

_ranksHelp: Ranks are text only - no artwork is shown on rank cards or the rank detail page. Copy a rank block { ... } to add another rank and delete a block to remove one. 'colour' can be a name (red, blue, green, teal, gold, ...) or any hex value such as #22c55e. 'price' can be per currency, one plain number in the base currency, or ready-made text like "$4.99". 'featured': true makes it the most popular rank. 'orderLink' is optional - leave it empty to use redirect.defaultOrderLink, then your Discord link.
